name: Boku no Ruriko no Bunny Kyouka Shuukan
original_name: 僕の瑠璃子のバニー強化週間
source: My wife, Ruri, couldn't refuse a friend's request to work part-time at a snack bar for a week, living in the house since it is far away. I hope nothing happened to her...
translation: My wife, Ruri, couldn't refuse a friend's request to work part-time at a snack bar for a week, living in the house since it is far away. I hope nothing happened to her...
